description.value: Steve's Poké Bar is an award-winning Hawaiian poké chain founded by Steve Huynh, who grew up between Vancouver and Honolulu and developed his recipes from authentic family traditions and local Hawaiian poké joints. The restaurant has earned over 10,000 five-star Google reviews and is voted Vancouver's best poké. Build-your-own and signature bowls — including plant-based options — are available for pick-up or delivery across multiple Lower Mainland locations.
